title: Restart configuration as an embedding
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $C$ be an amplified configuration. Fix a run index $j<r+1$ and a counter $c<r+2$. Suppose that every work tape in block $j$ is blank at every cell and has its head at cell $0$, and that the output is empty. Then restarting $C$ at run $j$ with counter $c$ gives the same configuration as embedding the restarted configuration at run $j$ with counter $c$, using $N$'s initial configuration on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
